answer: Each identity’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence requires sustained, verified honest service. A freshly spawned Sybil has near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted, independently corroborated links prevent cheap self-reinforcement, leaving it below consensus thresholds. A ridge separates signal from noise: this is no fable about a nebula of names, since without trusted paths and time, extra identities gain no voting weight.
